findings.title: Accept the recorded lsof cwd field format
findings.body: The successful recorded lsof -a -p ... -d cwd -Fpn command emits p<PID>, fcwd, n<cwd> for each PID. The two permitted editors therefore contribute six lines, but the rule requires four and consumes p/n pairs. With either permitted service present, the shared helper rejects valid cwd output in both the prepared retry capacity script and native run. The 24 synthetic controls omit fcwd and therefore do not exercise the observed positive format.
findings.recommended_fix: Parse strict p/fcwd/n records, retain duplicate/missing/malformed checks, and derive a positive control from the actual captured cwd blocks.
findings.evidence_type: Static source plus inspected executed parent receipt; reviewer did not run lsof or execute the candidate function.
findings.parent_disposition: Accepted; parent will preserve this frozen review and request a separate bounded repair review.
